sentences.text: If you bolt wings to a tube and roll it across a field, you have an airplane.
But at slow speed the wings lift nothing, and it only rolls along the grass.
So you add an engine and a propeller that pull it much faster.
But even fast, a Cessna 172S needs about 960 feet of ground roll before the wings lift it.
So you swing down flaps, which lets the wing lift sooner and the plane lifts off in a shorter distance.
Its curved top bends the air downward, so the wing is pushed up.
And air racing over the top to catch the air below is not what lifts a wing.
A symmetric wing still generates lift, because the wing throws air down and the plane goes up.
Add windows, a landing light and boarding stairs.
Congratulations, you have built an airplane.
